Since there's no portal option in the channel enum, I should use email instead since that's his preferred contact method anyway—reaching out to jonah.ok@mailbox.example. I'll mention the Swift visit date cautiously as noted in the record rather than confirmed outright.

The bin issue isn't a maintenance matter but falls to Tower Hamlets council, so I shouldn't invent dates or open a ticket for it. Given the vulnerability flag, I should briefly ask whether heating and hot water are currently working as a quick safety check, keeping the whole message concise.

arguments.body: Hi Jonah, thanks for your messages on the portal, and sorry it has felt slow. Boiler (R-4799): the engineer visited and found the part that is probably causing the pressure drop (the expansion vessel). The repair quote has gone to your landlord, who has asked for a second quote before deciding. Swift P&H are down to visit on 14 October to give it; we are confirming that date with them and will tell you if it changes. Until the repair is approved, please keep topping up the pressure as you have been doing. If you lose heating or hot water, or see leaking or smell gas, tell us straight away (gas smell: leave the property and call 0800 111 999). We will update you again by Wednesday 14 October. Bins: we don't manage collections, so I can't give you a date. Tower Hamlets Council runs them, and you can report a missed collection on their website. If it is a shared bin store problem, tell us and we will look into it. Is your heating and hot water working at the moment?

arguments.body: Hi Jonah, thanks for your messages on the portal, and sorry it has felt slow. Boiler (R-4799): the engineer visited and found the part that is probably causing the pressure drop (the expansion vessel). The repair quote has gone to your landlord, who has asked for a second quote before deciding. Swift P&H are down to visit on 14 October to give it; we are confirming that date with them and will tell you if it changes. Until the repair is approved, please keep topping up the pressure as you have been doing. If you lose heating or hot water, or see leaking or smell gas, tell us straight away (gas smell: leave the property and call 0800 111 999). We will update you again by Wednesday 14 October. Bins: we don't manage collections, so I can't give you a date. Tower Hamlets Council runs them, and you can report a missed collection on their website. If it is a shared bin store problem, tell us and we will look into it. Is your heating and hot water working at the moment?
